intro: Elder Hammershout is an ancient spirit visited during the Lunar Festival, standing outside the gates of Stormwind in Elwynn Forest. He rewards travelers who pause to honor his people and show reverence for the venerable heritage of Azeroth's elder races. His presence serves as a reminder of ancient bonds even in the heart of human territory.

paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
